result.instructions: Tools for Przelewy24, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which payments did we receive yesterday, and which are still waiting for the buyer?"; "Refund 50 PLN of order 123456 for session shop-7781."; "Which payment methods are available for a 120 PLN order in PLN?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Przelewy24 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run przelewy24_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run przelewy24_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run przelewy24_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. przelewy24_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: przelewy24_check_access
tools.title: Check API access
tools.description: Check that the account ID and reports key are accepted by Przelewy24 for the configured environment. Does not check the CRC key. REST: GET /api/v1/testAccess.

tools.name: przelewy24_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the payment methods enabled for the account, optionally for one amount and currency. Use it to choose the method ID for przelewy24_register_transaction. REST: GET /api/v1/payment/methods/{lang}.

amount.description: Optional amount in grosz, to check availability for that amount.

tools.name: przelewy24_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by your session ID: status, amount, order ID, payment method and dates. REST: GET /api/v1/transaction/by/sessionId/{sessionId}.

sessionId.description: Your unique session ID for the transaction (max 100 characters).

tools.name: przelewy24_get_refunds_for_order
tools.title: Get refunds for an order
tools.description: List the refund requests and their status for one Przelewy24 order ID. REST: GET /api/v1/refund/by/orderId/{orderId}.

tools.name: przelewy24_list_history
tools.title: List transaction history
tools.description: List the settlement history (batches, transactions, refunds) for a date range of at most 31 days. Dates are YYYYMMDD. REST: GET /api/v1/report/history.

dateTo.description: End date, YYYYMMDD. At most 31 days after dateFrom.

type.description: Limit the results to one object type.

tools.name: przelewy24_get_batch_details
tools.title: Get batch details
tools.description: Get the transactions in one settlement batch. Pass the token from the previous page to read the next page. REST: GET /api/v1/report/batch/details.

batch.description: Batch ID from the history report.

token.description: Next-page token from the previous reply.

tools.name: przelewy24_register_transaction
tools.title: Register a payment
tools.description: Register a new payment and get its payment-page link (redirect the buyer to paymentUrl). The buyer pays on Przelewy24's page. sessionId must be unique. Sign is calculated with the CRC key. REST: POST /api/v1/transaction/register.

sessionId.description: Your unique session ID for the transaction (max 100 characters).

description.description: Payment description shown to the buyer.

urlReturn.description: Page the buyer returns to after payment.

urlStatus.description: Address that receives the payment status notification.

method.description: Payment method ID from przelewy24_list_payment_methods. Omit to let the buyer choose.

timeLimit.description: Minutes allowed to pay (0 = no limit, max 99).

tools.name: przelewy24_refund_transaction
tools.title: Refund a transaction
tools.description: Request a refund of one or more transactions. requestId and refundsUuid must be unique per request. The refund result is sent asynchronously to urlStatus. REST: POST /api/v1/transaction/refund.

requestId.description: Your unique ID for this refund request (max 45 characters).

refundsUuid.description: Unique UUID-style ID for this refund batch (max 35 characters).

sessionId.description: Your unique session ID for the transaction (max 100 characters).

amount.description: Amount to refund in grosz: 1.23 PLN = 123.

urlStatus.description: Address that receives the refund result.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Przelewy24
prompts.description: What you can do with Przelewy24 here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_a_payment_and_the_refunds_of_its_order
prompts.title: Check a payment and the refunds of its order
prompts.description: Look up a payment by its session ID to read the status, amount, order ID and payment method. Then list the refund requests of its order.

prompts.name: confirm_api_access_and_list_payment_methods
prompts.title: Confirm API access and list payment methods
prompts.description: Check that the account ID and reports key work in the chosen environment. Then list the payment methods for an amount and currency.

prompts.name: review_settlement_batches_for_a_period
prompts.title: Review settlement batches for a period
prompts.description: List the settlement history for up to 31 days. Open a batch to read its transactions, one page at a time.

prompts.name: send_a_buyer_a_payment_link
prompts.title: Send a buyer a payment link
prompts.description: Register a payment with a unique session ID. Redirect the buyer to the returned payment link, where the buyer pays on Przelewy24's page.

prompts.name: refund_one_or_more_transactions
prompts.title: Refund one or more transactions
prompts.description: Request a refund for one or more transactions with unique request IDs. Then list the refunds of the order. The refund result arrives asynchronously at your status URL.
